scope: Local Fake X public-MCP regression for terminal cancellation receipt archival and custody on persistence failure.
acceptance: A successful terminal cancellation receipt is persisted before its payload is removed from the call's in-memory record.
interface_results reads the archived receipt for pending and finished action calls.
A duplicate cancellation after terminal completion reuses the same operation ID and produces no second Fake X release.
If receipt persistence fails, the terminal result remains available in memory and a duplicate does not start a new cleanup.
Action result, release_confirmed=false, task_success=null, cleanup UNKNOWN, and replay denial remain separate and conservative.
limits: This does not exercise the production X11 worker against Xlib or Xvfb.
This does not prove X-server rejection or draining of already queued effects.
This does not qualify physical input, task success, recovery, MAP01, efficiency, or reliability.
The terminal receipt archive remains on disk under existing per-call artifact retention; this run does not bound disk retention.
No WSLc or Docker allocation was used.
